paper_title: Can 1B LLM Surpass 405B LLM Rethinking Compute-Optimal Test-Time   Scaling
caption: Distribution of Pass@1 accuracy of Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct on MATH-500, divided into five bins.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of Pass@1 accuracy for the Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct model on the MATH-500 dataset, categorized into five bins along the horizontal axis labeled "Pass@1," which ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 in increments of 0.2. The vertical axis represents the percentage of instances falling within each bin, scaled from 0.0 to 0.8. The bars, colored light blue, show the following approximate percentages: 11.2% in the 0.0–0.2 bin, 3.4% in the 0.2–0.4 bin, 3.4% in the 0.4–0.6 bin, 5.8% in the 0.6–0.8 bin, and 76.2% in the 0.8–1.0 bin. A red dashed vertical line marks the mean Pass@1 accuracy of 0.82, which lies within the 0.8–1.0 bin, indicating that the majority of the model's performance falls at or near the highest accuracy range. The chart also includes a text annotation for the mean value, "mean: 0.82," positioned above the 0.8–1.0 bin.
